checks: Faction: two factions, eleven nations, explicit associated status
Faction: 22 valid perspectives, shared history, only French Verdun executable
Faction: all ten faction/year combinations browsable without invented playability
Faction: entry, political transition, withdrawal and invalid date boundaries
Faction: invalid mission identity and nation/date combinations rejected
Faction: locked missions cannot launch, settle or quick-resolve
Faction: repeated navigation stays isolated, normalizes countries and creates no progress
Faction: original v8 migration preserves resources, receipts, training, sound and history
Faction: settlement identity, first-clear and replay remain idempotent and faction scoped
Faction: four shared archetypes/doctrines, national variants and order ownership
Artillery countdown survives simultaneous major-assault messaging and pause
TIMING adds exactly 35% in exposed phase only
BARRAGE slows 20%; MG suppression 25% takes precedence then expires independently
Engineer radius is exclusive to repair-network branch; early branches rejected without spending
Simultaneous leaks clamp strength to zero and clear pending pressure
Wave 20 is the final assault and a major breach is decisive
Permanent engineer training improves actual support adjacency, not nonexistent damage
Audio opt-in, music/battle transition, mute/resume, hidden tab, single context and cleanup
Audio unavailable does not throw into gameplay
Independent v8 save, valid 3-type loadout, bounded permanent progression
Chronology, battle roster, field orders and routes
Budget, sell once, occupied/fractional slot and engineer-only start
Engineer adjacency affects costs and invalid branch does not spend resources
Pause and 2x preserve continuous simulation
No-cost idle defense fails and gives no first-clear reward
method: 27 deterministic engine runs with level 1 / Mk.I saves; automated tactical policy. No player data, cheats or injected resources.
